subject.title: [Feature]: Matrix QA lifecycle parity across Tuwunel and Crabline

question: Should maintainers resolve this issue by landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101055, or redirect the Matrix QA lifecycle contract before implementation?
rationale: The issue is maintainer-authored/protected, current main still lacks the requested lifecycle surface, and an open linked PR owns the implementation direction.

options.title: Review And Land Linked PR
options.body: Use the open PR as the implementation path after exact-head checks and maintainer review are satisfactory.

options.title: Redirect Lifecycle Design
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for changes if maintainers want a different substrate boundary than the linked PR proposes.

recommendation.title: Review And Land Linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the open PR as the implementation path after exact-head checks and maintainer review are satisfactory.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa introduced the current Matrix QA harness surface and owns the open linked implementation PR.
